methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: On the complete #5413 caller (unchanged invoice, profiles, reserve 1e-12, compiler tuple, BIT stock): is #5413's precision/height argument parametric in the strict compiler gap, and what endpoint does the finest admissible unit gap fund?
scope_change_reason: #5413's precision checker and conjunction pin the gap 1/7e11 and its carrier (j,H)=(55099,38569300000000000); our #5462 therefore stopped at kappa .0030272882389 although the alpha reserve allows tested values up to .003027288248978444. The written proof is symbolic in N=2^H, so the pin is a literal, not a mathematical obligation.
evidence: gap_endpoint.py: invoice byte-identical; funding PASS at gap 1/7e16 with recomputed least grid j=72096, H=5046720000000000000000; one-line gap-parametric precision checker is conservative at #5413's carrier and passes at the new one; written proof instantiated by four literal substitutions; 25/25 conjunction premises PASS with only endpoint/carrier literals moved; seven rejecting controls; every unit gap 1/(7*10^m), m=12..18, funds.
claim: Conditional kappa = .0030272882489783 (tested .0030272882489784; +1.00783e-11 over #5462, +1.39783e-11 over #5413) from funded compiler/precision headroom only; zero recursive economic saving; the precision argument admits every positive unit gap, so the only bound is tested < .003027288248978445 (alpha reserve).
